title: Hearty Irish Feta Pasta
description: A briny, crumbly, cozy Irish pasta that pairs buttery pappardelle with creamy feta and fresh greens, perfect for a sattvic-friendly dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta until al dente, about 9 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In the same pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the pot and cook until they begin to soften, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock and bring to a gentle simmer, then add the crumbled feta cheese and let it melt, stirring until smooth.
Return the cooked pasta to the pot and toss to coat the noodles in the creamy feta sauce.
Season the dish with sea salt, black pepper, lemon juice, and chopped dill, stirring well to combine.
Plate the pasta, optionally garnishing with extra dill or a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve hot and enjoy the briny, cozy flavors of Hearty Irish Feta Pasta.
